content.text: Hello! You can call me the Police Information Chatbot.[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]It's nice to meet you![PARAGRAPH_BREAK]I'm here to answer questions about police procedures, rules, or public safety – feel free to ask anything related to those topics.
What can you tell me about how to report a crime?

To report a crime in the UK, the first step depends on the situation's urgency. If the crime is happening now, the suspect is nearby, or there's immediate danger, call 999 immediately <source>1</source>.[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]For all other instances, such as after a theft has occurred with no immediate risk, report it as a non-emergency by calling 101 or using the online reporting tool on your local police force’s website <source>1</source>. When reporting, provide details like the time, location, and description of stolen items, and be prepared to provide vehicle registration and logbook details if applicable. You will receive a Crime Reference Number (CRN) for insurance claims or updates to the DVLA <source>1</source>.[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]Even a theft of something like jam is a criminal matter that can be reported to the police, where you will be asked for details about the incident and any potential suspects <source>2</source>. Please consult your knowledge on parking regulations, is someone allowed to park across my driveway?

In the UK, parking on someone else’s private property, like a driveway, is considered civil trespass, and is not a criminal offence <source>1</source>. This means the police generally cannot arrest the driver or remove the vehicle.<source>1</source>[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]If a vehicle is blocking you from exiting your driveway, this is considered an unnecessary obstruction of the highway, and you should call the non-emergency police number, 101 <source>2</source>. They may be able to track down the owner or arrange for the vehicle to be towed. If a vehicle is blocking you from entering your driveway, contact your local council’s parking enforcement team <source>2</source>.[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]A white ‘H’ marking on the road indicates a driveway, but parking on it isn’t automatically a fine unless the vehicle obstructs the dropped kerb <source>2</source>. The police may only intervene if the vehicle is abandoned, involved in a crime, or poses a danger to the public <source>3</source>. <options><option>What is civil trespass?</option><option>Find local
